full_judgment: 2. The facts, relevant for disposal of the instant civil petition for leave to appeal, are that the petitioner herein as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.3801 of 2008 before the Assistant Judge, Fourth Court, Gazipur, for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession. The plaintiff stated, inter alia, that the suit property belonged to Bhagaban Chandra Chanda, whose name was recorded in C.S. Khatian No.157. Bhagaban Chandra Chanda died leaving behind 5 sons, namely Bhupendra Chandra Chanda, Nripendra Chandra Chanda, Pabitra Chandra Chanda, Amulya Chandra Chanda and Shailendra alias Susil Chandra Chanda and their names have been recorded in the S.A. Khatian No.246 in the plot No.253 and they transferred 2.99 acres of land including the suit land to Sudhir Chandra Chanda, father of the plaintiff through kabala No.1419 dated 19.03.1969 and delivered possession. The plaintiff submitted the certified copy of the kabala No.1419 dated 19.03.1969 as the original has been destroyed by fire. Sudhir Chandra Chanda died leaving the plaintiff as the only son, who having got the suit land by inheritance being in peaceful possession of the same by paying the rents duly and R.S. Khatian No. 203 was wrongly recorded in the name of the defendants. Deed No.344 dated 02.02.1962 and deed No.977 dated 04.03.1963 had been fraudulently created by the defendants. The plaintiff went to the local Tashil Office on 25.09.2005 and came to know that R.S. Khatian No.203 has been recorded in the name of the defendants. Hence, the plaintiff filed the suit. After institution of the suit on 20.05.2006 the defendants dispossessed the plaintiff from the suit land and built a small but thereon. Therefore, the plaintiff prayed for decree for declaration of title as well as recovery of khan possession.
